findings: Snapshot is restricted to original rows 19 and 20. It runs after the existing frame_post_draw and immediately before synchronous LANE.save_frame, without a new await, tick, placement, pose, camera, formation_target, _validated_station or validator call.

Enumeration is limited to mounted CreatureBody-derived CharacterBody3D nodes in this world within 50 metres of the current camera. A 33rd nearby eligible actor produces an incomplete status and nonzero exit rather than silently truncating an accepted snapshot.

Directly matched EncounterDirector.ally_body alone receives director_current_ally role. ally_instance is a read-only existing RefCounted getter; other instance UIDs are marked as actual body.instance without ownership inference. owner_peer_id is separately nullable; stable character UID and unknown roles stay unavailable.
Body and Model transforms and is_visible_in_tree are recorded without mutation. Visibility does not establish pixel contribution, occlusion or the identity of an insect in a previous image.

Follower cache properties have the actual declared Vector3/integer types. The snapshot reads requested and validated offsets, validation leader and tick age. Current leader plus cached offset is labelled resolved_now, not a new validated station. Nonfinite values are encoded as explicit status plus null coordinates.

Final 17-line extension reads the existing mounted AuthoredRouteDetails/HighPerchesEdgeNature child only. It records current admitted child count, each Node3D placement transform, and a sole Node3D model root when present; missing pocket or model is explicit. It performs no grounding ray or placement and does not require or presume all 15 authored items were admitted.

Every successful target PNG receives its own image_path-associated exact JSON manifest line. Final flush/readback checks every whole snapshot line using split/newline membership. Missing world/camera or actor-cap failure additionally makes exit nonzero even in legacy mode; original named-preset skip and persistence guards remain.

No original row, stand, camera, time, fixture, party, geometry, visibility, PNG writer, selector or graphics bootstrap was changed. The final command binds the single combined shaft/edge/snapshot candidate; intermediate native commands are not requested by this review.
